verdict.rationale: x402 lets AI agents pay merchants directly: payments ride on HTTP 402 requests, and the docs describe x402-enabling a Payment Acceptance merchant checkout so agents can authorize payment sessions. MCP-compatible agents can also discover payable services through the Bazaar MCP server and pay mid-task from agentic wallets. However, no evidence shows purchases completed inside consumer chat surfaces such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot, and payment is limited to stablecoins in agent-held wallets. Missing for 10: documented in-chat checkout integrations with the named assistant surfaces, an end-user buyer flow inside chat, and independent or hands-on corroboration of assistant-surface purchases.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)

citations.quote: x402-enable a merchant checkout built on Payment Acceptance so agents can authorize payment sessions directly.
